title: Refund & Return Policy
content:
We want you to love what you buy. If something is not right, this page explains how returns and refunds work.

## Returns within 7 days

Unopened products can be returned within 7 days of delivery for a full refund.

The product must be unused, sealed, and in its original packaging, with any tamper seal, box and tags still attached.

## What cannot be returned

- Opened, used or tested skincare, makeup and hair care products (for hygiene and safety reasons).
- Products with a broken seal, missing packaging or visible damage caused after delivery.
- Items bought with a final-sale or clearance label.

## Damaged, wrong or expired items

If your order arrives damaged, leaking, expired or different from what you ordered, tell us within 48 hours of delivery and send clear photos of the product and the outer package.

We will replace the item or refund it in full, and we will cover the return delivery.

## How to request a return

1. Contact us from the Contact page with your order ID (for example AR-1042) and the reason for the return.
2. Wait for our confirmation message. Please do not send the parcel before we approve it.
3. Pack the product securely in its original packaging and hand it to the courier we arrange.
4. We check the item when it reaches us, then confirm your refund.

## How refunds are paid

Approved refunds are sent to the same method you paid with: your mobile wallet or card. For cash on delivery orders, we refund by mobile wallet or bank transfer; we will ask for the details.

Please allow 5 to 7 working days after we receive and check the product. Original delivery charges are not refunded unless the return is because of our mistake.

## Cancelling an order

You can cancel before your order is shipped. After it has shipped, please use the return process once it is delivered.

Need help with a return? [Contact us](/p/contact). See also our [Delivery Policy](/p/delivery).

title: Privacy Policy
content:
Your privacy matters to us. This page explains what information Make Me Pretty collects, why we collect it, and the choices you have.

## What we collect

- Your name, phone number, email address and delivery address when you place an order or create an account.
- Your order history and the items in your bag and wishlist.
- What you type into our Skin Advisor, such as skin concerns, so we can suggest suitable products.
- Basic technical details such as browser type and pages visited, to keep the site working well.

## How we use it

- To process, deliver and support your orders.
- To show your bag, wishlist and order tracking.
- To give you skincare suggestions that fit what you told us.
- To send order updates, and offers only if you agree to receive them.
- To prevent fraud and improve the website.

## Payments

We accept mobile wallet, card and cash on delivery. Payments are handled by the payment provider. We do not store your full card number or PIN on our own servers.

## Who we share it with

We share only what is needed with delivery partners (name, phone number and address) and payment providers so your order can reach you. We do not sell your personal information.

We may share information if the law requires it.

## Cookies and browser storage

We store small pieces of data in your browser, such as your shopping bag and wishlist, so they are still there when you come back. Clearing your browser data removes them.

## Your Skin Advisor information

The Skin Advisor gives general skincare suggestions. It is not medical advice, so please do not enter sensitive health details. If you have a painful, persistent or worsening skin problem, see a doctor or dermatologist.

## Keeping your data safe

We take reasonable steps to protect your information, including limiting who can access it. No website can promise perfect security, so please keep your password private.

## Your choices

- Ask to see the information we hold about you.
- Ask us to correct it or delete your account.
- Unsubscribe from offers at any time.

## Children

Our shop is meant for adults. If you are under 18, please shop with a parent or guardian.

## Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version is always on this page.

Questions about your information? [Contact us](/p/contact).

title: Delivery Policy
content:
Here is how and when your Make Me Pretty order reaches you.

## Delivery times

- Inside Chittagong: 1 to 2 working days
- Other cities and districts: 2 to 4 working days

## Delivery areas

We deliver nationwide across Bangladesh.

## Delivery charges

Free delivery on orders over ৳3,000, nationwide.

For smaller orders, the delivery charge for your area is shown at checkout before you pay.

## Order processing

Orders are packed and handed to the courier within 1 working day after they are confirmed. Orders placed late at night, on Fridays or on public holidays are processed on the next working day.

## Paying on delivery

Cash on delivery is available. Please keep the exact amount ready for the delivery person. You can also pay by mobile wallet or card at checkout.

## When you receive your parcel

- Check that the outer package is not torn, wet or opened.
- If it looks damaged, tell the delivery person and take photos before you accept it.
- Report any problem within 48 hours of delivery (see our Refund & Return Policy).

## Missed deliveries

If you are not reachable, the courier will try again. After repeated failed attempts, the order may be returned to us and we will contact you to arrange a new delivery.

## Delays

Weather, strikes, festivals and other events outside our control can slow delivery. We will keep you updated and do our best to get your order to you quickly.

Want to see where your order is? [Track your order](/track). Problem with a delivery? [Contact us](/p/contact).

title: Terms & Condition
content:
Please read these terms before you use Make Me Pretty or place an order.

## 1. Using our website

By browsing or buying from Make Me Pretty, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree to be bound by this User Agreement, please do not access, register with, or use this Site.

You agree to give correct information when you order or create an account, and to keep your password private.

## 2. Products and descriptions

We try to show colours, sizes and details accurately, but screens differ and slight variations can happen. Product information, ingredients and prices may change without notice.

Skincare results vary from person to person. Please read the ingredient list and do a patch test if you have sensitive skin or allergies.

## 3. Prices and payment

- All prices are in Bangladeshi Taka (৳).
- We accept Bkash, VISA card and cash on delivery.
- We may cancel an order if a price or stock listing was wrong, and we will refund anything you already paid.

## 4. Offers and coupon codes

Offers and codes (such as GLOW20) have their own conditions and end dates. One code can normally be used per order, and codes cannot be exchanged for cash.

## 5. Orders

Placing an order is an offer to buy. It becomes a confirmed order when we confirm it. We may decline or cancel an order, for example if an item is out of stock or we cannot verify the details.

## 6. Delivery, returns and refunds

Delivery and returns follow our policies, which form part of these terms.

[Delivery Policy](/p/delivery) · [Refund & Return Policy](/p/refund-return)

## 7. Skin Advisor

The Skin Advisor gives general skincare suggestions from products in our shop. It is not medical advice and does not replace a doctor or dermatologist. Please seek professional help for any painful, persistent or worsening skin condition.

## 8. Your account

You are responsible for activity on your account. Tell us straight away if you think someone else has used it. We may suspend accounts that are used unfairly or against these terms.

## 9. Our content

The logo, text, images and design on this site belong to Make Me Pretty or its partners. Please do not copy or reuse them without our written permission.

## 10. Limits of our responsibility

We take care to provide a reliable service, but we cannot promise the site will always be available or free of errors. To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for indirect losses, and our responsibility for an order is limited to the amount you paid for it.

## 11. Changes and governing law

We may update these terms, and the latest version is always on this page. These terms are governed by the laws of Bangladesh.

Questions about these terms? [Contact us](/p/contact).
